Registration name: Rina Herholdt
Exhibition name: Rina Herholdt
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jan A. Herholdt (South Africa, before 1958).
Introduced in South Africa by Herholdt's Nursery/J.A. Herholdt in 1962 as 'Rina Herholdt'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, deep pink edges, ages to darker . Moderate fragrance. up to 60 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, very full (41+ petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Glossy, leathery foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
